thread:
harper: Heads-up — tonight 23:00–00:30 UTC we'll perform an evening drain of a small west-1 GPU pool to exercise graceful degradation and validate the new weighted-fallback policy. Expect a brief p99 latency uptick (up to ~5%) for ~20–30m. Plan + dashboard: https://redwood.company/runbooks/evening-drain-2026 :warning:

mia: linking runbook + run order. Steps: 1) pre-warm KV cache prefixes 2) shift 10% traffic -> fallback variant 3) monitor p50/p95/p99 & error budget 4) escalate if >1% error budget burn. https://redwood.internal/playbooks/drain-runbook.md :point_up:

oliver: can we confirm rollback owner? also what metrics to watch for automatic rollback?@danielle
danielle: I'll own rollback tonight. Auto-rollback triggers: sustained p99 > baseline + 3*stddev for 10m OR error-rate >0.8% for 5m. Rollback command is simple: ```/runbooks/ops rollback --pool west-1-drain```. I'll be on pager. :iphone:

sre-bot: scheduled task created: evening-drain-west1 at 2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Notifying channels: #eng-sre, #prod-ops.

harper: Traffic shift schedule (controlled canary): 23:05 UTC -> 10% for 10m, 23:15 -> 25% for 10m, 23:25 -> 50% for 10m, 23:35 -> 100% fallback (if all green) then drain complete. If any threshold breach -> immediate halt and rollback. We'll run a parallel short loadtest at 23:10 to simulate burst. :racehorse:

oliver: quick note — observability retention tweak for the test: high-fidelity traces will be retained for 72h instead of default 7d to save costs. Logs/metrics remain 30d. I've updated the retention flag: `observability.retention.test_run = 72h`. Notify compliance if needed. :memo:

mia: updated console dashboard widgets: per-route p99, error budget burn chart, and gating flag state. Link: https://console.redwood.company/dashboards/evening-drain-west1

harper: small reminder on routing policy: weighted-fallback prefers cheaper quantized variant when latency is within threshold. If fallback increases inference cost significantly, ops will pause and we'll roll back. This test also validates KV prefix prefill heuristics. :mag:

ops-bot: pre-warm job started for prefixes: kv://prefill/west1/active (expected finish 23:03 UTC). Logs: https://logs.redwood.company/job/31223

oliver: tagging @support to expect a small uptick in customer queries ~23:05–23:40 UTC, please have the canned note ready.

danielle: all set on my side. Slack status -> watching, will POST updates here if we trigger rollback. :thumbsup:

harper: If things go sideways we'll pause and open an incident channel. Otherwise expect a short summary in #eng-sre + postmortem doc in /incidents/ by tomorrow. Thanks team. :rocket:
